basis: PubMed esearch 2026-10-21: "Ehlers-Danlos Syndrome"[MeSH Terms] = 4,142 PMIDs (3,104 dated <=2018, 1,075 >=2019); compared against the EDS paper registry v2 (all statuses) and the POTS corpus paper set
note: recall of the EDS literature as PubMed indexes it is 4,140/4,142 (99.95%); the binding constraint is not discovery but text availability: 1,360 MeSH-indexed EDS papers (32.8%) have neither abstract nor full text through Europe PMC/PubMed and are recorded not_extractable; 148 MeSH-indexed papers were excluded by the population screen and are listed for human review (audits/mesh_indexed_but_excluded_148.csv); 107 were dispatched and yielded nothing.
